content.short: MemeTools is a crypto data aggregator and listing platform for meme coins.
content.description: MemeTools consolidates meme-token data for investors seeking the next DOGE or SHIB and for developers aiming to gain visibility. It includes rug and scam checks for listed tokens and provides tokenomics details such as honeypot status, whether liquidity is locked, and holdings of the top wallets. The platform delivers trading charts and extensive historical data drawn directly from the blockchain, including volume, transaction counts, and liquidity trends. It also offers a cross-chain swap feature that enables bridging assets across supported networks via a cross-chain bridge.
